CmdAspect.description: The IEC 81346 aspect of a structure tree (doc 03 §5).

CmdIdent.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

CmdMlText.description: Multilingual text: a neutral string, or an object keyed by canonical BCP 47 tags in ascending order with non-empty string values (doc 05 §3.2).

CmdUuid.description: A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

description:
`structure.create_node`: one identifier in one aspect tree (doc 03 §5, FR-PRJ-017).

Creates `StructureNode {aspect, code, aliases (sorted set), parent, description, order: 0}`. Rejected:
the product aspect (the device tree is never a structure node); a parent of another aspect
(EW-INV-011, checked here with a message); a sibling (same aspect and parent) with the same code. The
parent must exist. Outcome: the new node.

aliases.description: Import spellings that map to this node.

parent.description: The parent node of the same aspect.

title: structure.create_node
